name: nativeskill
description: Meaning-first app localization: add a language or audit translations that sound like machine translation.

interface.shortDescription: Add a language or fix translations that mean the wrong action.
interface.longDescription: NativeSkill helps coding agents add a locale or audit an existing catalog. It makes the agent name the UI intent before choosing words, keeps placeholders and CLDR plurals intact, and labels every proposal source-attested, draft, or uncovered.
defaultPrompt: Use NativeSkill to add Tamil and Malay from our English catalog.
Audit the Arabic strings. A few sound like machine translation.
The subscription Cancel button reads like a dialog Cancel. Fix the wording.
